name: MNEE
who_can_redeem: Verified MNEE customers may issue and redeem MNEE directly with MNEE Limited under the current terms. Holders who are not verified MNEE customers do not have a direct redemption right through the issuer channel.
minimum_redemption: 100000 USD equivalent under the reviewed terms
redemption_region_notes: Direct issuance and redemption are subject to MNEE customer verification, sanctions and jurisdiction controls, and current issuer terms.
redemption_notes: The reviewed terms state a fiat-redemption minimum of USD 100,000 and a redemption fee equal to the greater of USD 5,000 or 0.5% of the redemption amount.
summary: USD-referenced stablecoin issued by MNEE Limited, launched on 1Sat Ordinals in March 2025 and also issued as an ERC-20 token on Ethereum, with issuer terms for 1:1 reserve backing and verified-customer issuance and redemption.
notes: PR #498 complete-record promotion. Exact 1Sat token ID and Ethereum contract are recorded. Current reserve allocations, custodian identity, latest attestation report-body figures, Ethereum first-issuance date, and issuer-control capabilities remain explicit known unknowns.

name: Bison Bank Electronic Money Token — Euro
who_can_redeem: Pre-approved institutional partners that maintain the required Bison Bank relationship, pass current AML/KYC checks, and use an approved Solana-compatible wallet may request redemption at par under the reviewed terms.
minimum_redemption: not stated in the reviewed public sources
redemption_region_notes: Direct access is restricted to approved institutional partners and approved wallets. A complete current partner, customer-type, jurisdiction, and approved-wallet inventory is not published in the reviewed sources.
redemption_notes: The reviewed whitepaper describes redemption processing within two Lisbon business days after compliance checks and transfer of the tokens. Current fees and minimums were not established.
summary: Euro-referenced electronic-money token issued by Bison Bank, S.A. for pre-approved institutional partners, with 1:1 issuance and redemption claims and an allowlisted Solana Token-2022 deployment whose exact mint address is not published in the reviewed official sources.
notes: PR #517 complete-record promotion. The official public launch date is 2026-05-06; the whitepaper states an offer start date of 2026-04-10. Exact first mint, circulating supply, Solana mint address, reserve allocation, custodian, token-specific assurance, fees, minimums, and current control-role assignments remain explicit known unknowns.

name: JPYR
who_can_redeem: No reviewed public source establishes a direct holder redemption right, eligible redemption counterparty, or legal redemption obligor.
redemption_region_notes: The reviewed public material does not establish a direct issuer redemption channel or jurisdiction-specific redemption eligibility. A previously documented IZAKA-YA/CryptoPanda transaction route was terminated by CryptoPanda on 2026-08-25; this is an access/off-ramp deterioration signal and is not treated as proof that JPYR itself lost its peg or became non-redeemable.
redemption_notes: Operator/editorial material describes a one-yen target and backing or collateral concepts, but no reviewed source establishes the complete legal redemption mechanism, obligor, settlement terms, fees, minimums, or holder priority. The 2026-08-24 IZAKA-YA account-level withdrawal restrictions and the 2026-08-25 CryptoPanda integration termination affect a documented ecosystem access route but do not establish a direct JPYR issuer redemption failure.
summary: Ethereum ERC-20 token targeting 1 JPY per JPYR. Reviewed IZAKA-YA-affiliated public material identifies a JPYR Organization and publishes the Ethereum contract, but gives materially inconsistent descriptions of backing and does not establish an independently reviewed reserve series or direct holder redemption right. In August 2026, IZAKA-YA disclosed account-level withdrawal restrictions and CryptoPanda ended its IZAKA-YA wallet integration, creating an additional access/off-ramp concern without establishing a JPYR depeg or issuer redemption failure.
notes: Canonical inclusion and active status are not safety endorsements. Reviewed operator/editorial material itself states that JPYR was not registered with Japan's FSA as of June 2026, that the smart contract had not received a formal third-party audit, and that liquidity was limited. On 2026-08-24 IZAKA-YA disclosed temporary transfer/withdrawal restrictions for some accounts; on 2026-08-25 CryptoPanda terminated its IZAKA-YA partnership and disabled IZAKA-YA-wallet-connected transactions; on 2026-08-27 IZAKA-YA stated that there was no universal withdrawal halt and that individually reviewed transfers were being processed. SOG preserves these as ecosystem access and counterparty-route facts and does not infer depeg, reserve impairment, universal withdrawal failure, or direct issuer redemption failure from them.
